title: Ellsworth radar-jet chase and Bismarck lights
place_text: Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota and Bismarck, North Dakota

tellings.quote: On August 5th, 1953, a trained civilian spotter calls into the base.

plain: On August 5, 1953, a trained civilian sky-watcher called Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota to report something, which led to objects being tracked on radar and chased by jets, along with lights seen over Bismarck, North Dakota. Michels tells it from the files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, and the account of an Air Force officer named Edward J. Ruppelt, as a case where the military itself took part.
